# Spotify in Rocola

All Spotify access goes through the `Rocola.Spotify` behaviour (`lib/rocola/spotify.ex`).
Adapters: `Fake` (dev/test default, no token) and `Web` (real API, stub). Never call an adapter directly.

## Recipe for a new Spotify capability
1. Add a `@callback` and a delegating function in `Rocola.Spotify`.
2. Implement it in `Fake` AND stub it in `Web` (`{:error, :not_implemented}`), same change.
3. Put queue/limit/vote rules in `Rocola.Jukebox`, never in the adapter.
4. LiveViews call `Rocola.Jukebox`/`Rocola.Spotify`, never `Req` or `Repo`.
5. Tests use the Fake (`Rocola.Spotify.Fake.reset/0` in `setup`), never the network.
6. `mix precommit` must pass.

## Real API rules the Fake must mirror
- The queue is add-only: no remove, no reorder. Skips, votes and per-guest limits live in Rocola's own
  SQLite queue; send Spotify one song ahead. Never add a "remove from queue" callback.
- Playback commands need Premium and an active device. Devices only appear while awake.
- Devices with `is_restricted: true` are shown unavailable and never get commands.
- Success is often `204 No Content` with no body: don't pattern-match on a body.
- `429` carries a `Retry-After` header (seconds): wait that long, then retry once.
- There is no push for track changes: poll `now_playing` (or broadcast over PubSub from the context that owns playback).

## Real adapter (later)
Authorization Code flow; access token refreshed only by `Rocola.Spotify.TokenServer`; never log or store
tokens elsewhere. Scopes: `user-read-playback-state`, `user-modify-playback-state`,
`user-read-currently-playing`. Endpoint details: `reference/endpoints.md`.

cat > lib/rocola/jukebox.ex <<'E'
defmodule Rocola.Jukebox do
  @moduledoc """
  Queue/vote rules. Skip votes: 2 distinct guests voting on the current song skips it.
  """
  use Agent
  alias Rocola.Spotify

  @votes_needed 2

  # ponytail: votes live in memory (lost on restart, which is fine for one song); move to SQLite with the queue.
  def start_link(_), do: Agent.start_link(fn -> %{uri: nil, voters: MapSet.new()} end, name: __MODULE__)

  @doc "Test helper: forget all votes."
  def reset, do: Agent.update(__MODULE__, fn _ -> %{uri: nil, voters: MapSet.new()} end)

  @doc """
  Records `guest_id`'s vote to skip the current song. Repeat votes don't count twice;
  votes reset when the song changes. Returns `{:ok, {:voted, count}}` or `{:ok, :skipped}`.
  """
  def vote_skip(guest_id) do
    with {:ok, %{uri: uri}} <- now_playing() do
      Agent.get_and_update(__MODULE__, fn st ->
        voters = if st.uri == uri, do: st.voters, else: MapSet.new()
        voters = MapSet.put(voters, guest_id)

        if MapSet.size(voters) >= @votes_needed do
          case Spotify.skip() do
            :ok -> {{:ok, :skipped}, %{uri: nil, voters: MapSet.new()}}
            err -> {err, %{uri: uri, voters: voters}}
          end
        else
          {{:ok, {:voted, MapSet.size(voters)}}, %{uri: uri, voters: voters}}
        end
      end)
    end
  end

  defp now_playing do
    case Spotify.now_playing() do
      {:ok, nil} -> {:error, :nothing_playing}
      other -> other
    end
  end
end
E
cat > test/rocola/jukebox_test.exs <<'E'
defmodule Rocola.JukeboxTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
  alias Rocola.{Jukebox, Spotify}

  setup do
    Spotify.Fake.reset()
    Jukebox.reset()
    [a, b, c] = Enum.take(elem(Spotify.search(""), 1), 3)
    :ok = Spotify.transfer_playback("fake-living-room")
    for t <- [a, b, c], do: :ok = Spotify.add_to_queue(t.uri)
    %{a: a, b: b, c: c}
  end

  test "nothing playing" do
    Spotify.Fake.reset()
    assert {:error, :nothing_playing} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
  end

  test "one guest voting twice doesn't skip", %{a: a} do
    assert {:ok, {:voted, 1}} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
    assert {:ok, {:voted, 1}} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
    assert {:ok, ^a} = Spotify.now_playing()
  end

  test "2 distinct guests skip to the next song, votes reset", %{b: b, c: c} do
    assert {:ok, {:voted, 1}} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
    assert {:ok, :skipped} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g2")
    assert {:ok, ^b} = Spotify.now_playing()
    assert {:ok, {:voted, 1}} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
    assert {:ok, :skipped} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g3")
    assert {:ok, ^c} = Spotify.now_playing()
  end

  test "votes don't carry over when the song changes", %{b: b} do
    assert {:ok, {:voted, 1}} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g1")
    :ok = Spotify.skip()
    assert {:ok, ^b} = Spotify.now_playing()
    assert {:ok, {:voted, 1}} = Jukebox.vote_skip("g2")
  end
end
E

defmodule Rocola.Jukebox do
  @moduledoc """
  Queue/vote rules. Skip votes: 2 distinct guests voting on the current song skips it.
  """
  use Agent
  alias Rocola.Spotify

  @votes_needed 2

  # ponytail: votes live in memory (lost on restart, which is fine for one song); move to SQLite with the queue.
  def start_link(_), do: Agent.start_link(fn -> %{uri: nil, voters: MapSet.new()} end, name: __MODULE__)

  @doc "Test helper: forget all votes."
  def reset, do: Agent.update(__MODULE__, fn _ -> %{uri: nil, voters: MapSet.new()} end)

  @doc """
  Records `guest_id`'s vote to skip the current song. Repeat votes don't count twice;
  votes reset when the song changes. Returns `{:ok, {:voted, count}}` or `{:ok, :skipped}`.
  """
  def vote_skip(guest_id) do
    with {:ok, %{uri: uri}} <- now_playing() do
      Agent.get_and_update(__MODULE__, fn st ->
        voters = if st.uri == uri, do: st.voters, else: MapSet.new()
        voters = MapSet.put(voters, guest_id)

        if MapSet.size(voters) >= @votes_needed do
          case Spotify.skip() do
            :ok -> {{:ok, :skipped}, %{uri: nil, voters: MapSet.new()}}
            err -> {err, %{uri: uri, voters: voters}}
          end
        else
          {{:ok, {:voted, MapSet.size(voters)}}, %{uri: uri, voters: voters}}
        end
      end)
    end
  end

  defp now_playing do
    case Spotify.now_playing() do
      {:ok, nil} -> {:error, :nothing_playing}
      other -> other
    end
  end
end
E
